s10 FAQ: What teams ask before they switch.
Something we haven’t covered? The team that builds Synnax is happy to walk you through it.
Who counts as an employee on the bill?
Anyone you pay through Synnax in a given month, contractors included. Someone who leaves stops counting from the month after their final pay run.
Yes. Move up at any time and the difference is prorated on your next invoice. On yearly billing, a move down takes effect when the year renews.
How long does it take to move our payroll over?

Most teams run their first pay run on Synnax within two to four weeks. We import your people, pay history and year-to-date totals, then run one payroll alongside your current provider so you can compare before switching.
Do the agents change anything without asking?
No. Agents prepare pay runs, approvals and documents, but anything that touches pay or a record waits for a named person to approve it. Every action is logged with who approved it and when.
Where is our employee data stored?
Records are encrypted at rest and in transit on every plan. On Enterprise you can keep them in South Africa, the EU or the US, close to where your people are.
Does Synnax work with our accounting software?
Yes. Pay runs post to Xero, QuickBooks and Sage, payments can go out through Wise, and approvals and reminders reach people in Slack or Teams.
Can we offer Synnax to our own clients?

Yes. Payroll bureaus, accounting firms and employers of record can run Synnax under their own name, colours and domain, with a separate workspace for each client. White labeling is part of Enterprise.
